mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances despite the demand signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply-side signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals tightening monetary conditions and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening and inflation signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the last month, combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the housing demand signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is rising and Real GDP (GDPC1) is above its 12-month moving average, the combination signals robust supply-side and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply-side and growth signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
